name: software-localizer
description: Translate a software project into another language, or audit the translation it already has, with literary-translator's discipline: a canon and glossary decided once so every term is named the same way, translation in small batches through script checks and a model review, a resumable ledger that never overwrites a person's edit, and a report for a native speaker. Collecting strings and exporting translations is a per-project adapter written when the plugin is used, accepted only after mechanical round-trip and coverage checks.
